description: This file implements the 'ThroughputAnalyzer' class, which measures network throughput based on active requests, response sizes, and network conditions. It manages throughput observation windows, handles request lifecycle events, and detects hanging requests.

classes.name: ThroughputAnalyzer
classes.description: A class that estimates network throughput by tracking active requests, response sizes, and network quality metrics. It manages observation windows, handles request events, and detects hanging requests to provide throughput measurements.

methods.name: MaybeStartThroughputObservationWindow
methods.description: Starts a throughput measurement window if conditions are met, such as no degrading requests and sufficient active requests.

methods.name: EndThroughputObservationWindow
methods.description: Ends the current throughput measurement window, resetting related state.

methods.name: IsCurrentlyTrackingThroughput
methods.description: Checks if a throughput observation window is active and conditions are suitable for throughput measurement.

methods.name: UpdateResponseContentSize
methods.description: Updates the stored response size for a given request.

methods.name: NotifyStartTransaction
methods.description: Handles the start of a request, updating content size and managing request tracking.

methods.name: NotifyBytesRead
methods.description: Updates request activity when bytes are read.

methods.name: NotifyRequestCompleted
methods.description: Handles request completion, computes throughput, and triggers callbacks.

methods.name: NotifyExpectedResponseContentSize
methods.description: Sets expected response size for a request.

methods.name: IsHangingWindow
methods.description: Determines if a request is hanging based on received bits and duration.

methods.name: MaybeGetThroughputObservation
methods.description: Attempts to compute and report current throughput if conditions are met.

methods.name: OnConnectionTypeChanged
methods.description: Handles network connection type changes, marking requests as degrading accuracy.

methods.name: SetUseLocalHostRequestsForTesting
methods.description: Sets a flag for testing with localhost requests.

methods.name: GetBitsReceived
methods.description: Returns total bits received from network activity.

methods.name: CountActiveInFlightRequests
methods.description: Returns the number of active in-flight requests.

methods.name: CountTotalInFlightRequests
methods.description: Returns total number of in-flight requests.

methods.name: CountTotalContentSizeBytes
methods.description: Returns total response content size in bytes.

methods.name: DegradesAccuracy
methods.description: Determines if a request degrades throughput measurement accuracy.

methods.name: BoundRequestsSize
methods.description: Ensures request collections do not exceed maximum size, disabling measurements if necessary.

methods.name: EraseHangingRequests
methods.description: Removes requests considered hanging based on network conditions.
